landing.headline: Meet people who feel real
landing.legal: By signing up, you agree to our Terms. See how we use your data in our Privacy Policy.

email.title: What’s your email?
email.subtitle: We’ll use it to create your account and keep things secure.
email.label: Email address
email.hint: We’ll send you a 6-digit code. No password to remember.
email.privacy: We never share your email with anyone and it won’t appear on your profile.
email.invalid: Please enter a valid email address.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.subtitle: We’ve sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
verify.resent: A new code is on its way.
verify.warning: Never share this code with anyone. Flinger will never ask for it.

unreachable.title: Can’t reach Flinger
unreachable.body: Check your internet connection and try again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK: Could not reach Flinger. Check your connection.
errors.OTP_INVALID: That code is not right. Please try again.
errors.OTP_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.OTP_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong codes. Request a new one.
errors.OTP_COOLDOWN: Please wait a moment before asking for a new code.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: This account is not available. Please contact support.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: We couldn’t send the email. Please try again in a moment.
errors.PROFILE_UNDERAGE: You must be at least 18 to use Flinger.
errors.BIRTHDATE_LOCKED: Your birthday can’t be changed. Contact support if it’s wrong.
errors.PROMPT_NOT_FOUND: That prompt is no longer available. Please choose another.
errors.CONSENT_VERSION_MISMATCH: These terms have been updated. Please review them again.
errors.PHOTO_LIMIT_REACHED: You can add up to 6 photos. Remove one to add another.
errors.PHOTO_UPLOAD_MISSING: We didn’t receive that photo. Please try again.
errors.PHOTO_INVALID_IMAGE: That file isn’t a supported photo.
errors.PHOTO_MINIMUM: Your profile needs at least 4 photos.
errors.PHOTO_UPLOAD_FAILED: The photo upload failed. Please try again.
errors.LOCATION_MOCKED: Your location looks simulated. Turn off any fake-GPS app and try again.
errors.LOCATION_OUTSIDE_SERVICE_AREA: Flinger is only available in India for now.
errors.LOCATION_TOO_INACCURATE: We couldn’t get an accurate location. Please try again.
errors.LOCATION_STALE: That location was out of date. Please try again.
errors.ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE: A few steps are still missing.
errors.LIKE_LIMIT_REACHED: You’ve used all your likes for today.
errors.LIKE_ITEM_INVALID: That photo or prompt is no longer on their profile.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: This profile is no longer available.
errors.DISCOVERY_NOT_READY: Finish your profile to start discovering.

onboarding.editLater: You can edit this later from your profile.

name.title: Let’s get to know you
name.subtitle: You must be at least 18 years old to use this app.
name.birthdayLocked: Your birthday is set and can’t be changed.
name.note: Only your age is shown on your profile, never your birthdate.
name.invalidName: Please enter your first name (2 to 30 letters).
name.underage: You must be at least 18 to use Flinger.
name.confirmBody: You were born on {{date}}, so you’re {{age}}. You can’t change this later.

gender.title: Tell us a bit about you
gender.subtitle: This helps us personalize your experience and show you more relevant matches.
gender.question: How do you identify?

whoToMeet.title: Who would you like to meet?
whoToMeet.subtitle: Select everyone you’re open to meeting. You can change this anytime.
whoToMeet.note: Only people who also want to meet you will appear.

intentions.title: What are you hoping to find right now?

height.title: How tall are you?
height.subtitle: Scroll to choose your height. It shows on your profile.

values.title: What do you value most in a person?

kids.title: Kids & family plans
kids.subtitle: This helps set expectations. You can skip or change it anytime.
kids.future: What about kids in the future?

causes.title: Causes & communities you care about
causes.subtitle: Pick up to {{count}} causes that matter to you most.

prompts.title: Add 3 prompts
prompts.subtitle: Prompts give people something to talk about. Keep each answer under {{max}} characters.

agree.title: Almost there
agree.subtitle: Please review these before you start meeting people.
agree.docSoon: This document is being finalised and will be available before launch.
agree.terms: I’m 18 or older and I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
agree.guidelines: I’ll be kind and honest, and follow the Community Guidelines.

photos.title: Show your best self
photos.subtitle: Add at least {{min}} photos. Your first photo is your main photo.
photos.tips: Clear face, good light, and one photo of just you work best. Photos are checked before others can see them.

location.title: Discover people near you
location.subtitle: Location access helps us show you people around you so connections feel real and relevant.
location.privacy: People only see how far away you are, like “3 km away”. Your exact location is never shown.
location.denied: Flinger needs your location to show you people nearby.
location.blocked: Location is off for Flinger. Turn it on in Settings › Flinger › Location, then come back.
location.unavailable: We couldn’t get your location. Please try again.

discover.widened: Nobody new nearby, so we’re showing people within {{km}} km.

empty.title: You’re all caught up
empty.body: New people appear as they join near you. Widening your distance or age range can show you more.

limit.title: You’ve used all {{count}} likes today
limit.body: Your likes reset at 4:00 AM. You can keep looking and passing, and people who like you will still show up.

match.title: It’s a match!
match.body: You and {{name}} liked each other. Say hello while the spark is fresh.

likedYou.title: Liked You
likedYou.subtitle_one: {{count}} person liked your profile. Like them back to start a conversation.
likedYou.subtitle_other: {{count}} people liked your profile. Like them back to start a conversation.
likedYou.empty: When someone likes you, they’ll show up here.

chats.title: Chats
chats.empty: When you match with someone, you can chat here.

me.title: Profile
me.soon: Editing your profile, preferences and settings are coming next.

thread.matchedHint: Say hello and ask about something on their profile.
thread.offline: You’re offline. Messages will send when you’re back online.
thread.unmatchBody: You won’t see each other again and this conversation will be removed for both of you.

primer.title: Stay in the loop
primer.body: Enable notifications so you never miss new matches, messages, or important updates.
